description.p: Podcast Merlin is a modern, cross-platform podcast client featuring native Nextcloud Podcast and gPodder.net synchronization, designed for Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android.

ul.li: Bi-directional Nextcloud and gPodder synchronization for podcast subscriptions and episode playback positions
Interactive "Up Next" queue with drag-and-drop reordering, swipe removal, and continuous playback
Sleep timer with preset durations, real-time countdown, and graceful audio fade-out
Variable playback speed (0.5x to 3.0x in 0.1x increments) and customizable skip intervals
Search and discover trending podcasts via Apple Podcasts directory
Resilient episode downloads with pause, resume, storage quota control, and auto-cleanup policies
Native Linux desktop integration with Wayland support, system theme detection, and MPRIS media player keys

screenshot.caption: Podcast Merlin player with Now Playing screen and active queue

description.p: Initial release with Nextcloud and gPodder sync, queue management, and Linux desktop integration.
